front: What is PHP-FPM in one sentence?
back: FastCGI Process Manager: the worker pool between Nginx/Apache and PHP — production default for PHP on Linux.

front: Explain the mental model of PHP-FPM (how the system thinks).
back: Nginx terminates TLS and forwards requests to PHP-FPM over TCP or a Unix socket. FPM maintains a pool of worker processes; each worker handles one request at a time (unless you use async frameworks, which is rare in PHP).

front: Symptom: 502 on all PHP routes — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: ls -la /run/php/*.sock; systemctl status php-fpm · Fix: FPM down; socket path mismatch vs Nginx fastcgi_pass

front: Symptom: 502 intermittent — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: curl fpm-status; check listen queue · Fix: Pool exhausted — raise pm.max_children or fix slow queries

front: Symptom: 502 after deploy — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Nginx error log: connect() to unix:... failed (13: Permission denied) · Fix: listen.owner/group/mode — Nginx user must be in socket group

front: Symptom: 504 gateway timeout — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Nginx fastcgi_read_timeout; FPM request_terminate_timeout · Fix: Long-running script; async job queue instead

front: Symptom: 500 with blank body — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: FPM /var/log/php8.3-fpm.log, app error_log · Fix: PHP fatal; display_errors=Off in prod hides from client

front: Symptom: Memory climb over days — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: pm.max_requests = 0 · Fix: Enable recycling; audit extension leaks (imagick, etc.)

front: Symptom: All workers busy, low CPU — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: DB lock / external API · Fix: Slowlog pinpoints line; not a pool sizing problem

front: Gotcha with PHP-FPM: what silently fails?
back: Socket path drift — distro upgrades rename /run/php/php7.4-fpm.sock → php8.3. Nginx still points at old path → instant 502 after apt upgrade.

front: When should you NOT use PHP-FPM?
back: CLI/cron scripts — invoke php directly, not FPM. Long-lived WebSockets in PHP — wrong tool; use Node/Go or a dedicated WS gateway. ondemand in prod — first-request latency after idle spikes; use dynamic.

front: What is PHP errors in one sentence?
back: Apache/PHP-FPM startup and runtime failures — read the error log line, fix the socket/port/config mismatch.

front: Explain the mental model of PHP errors (how the system thinks).
back: PHP in production usually sits behind Apache (mod_php rare now) or Nginx → PHP-FPM (Unix socket or TCP). "No listening sockets" means the web server couldn't bind its port — often Apache still running or port 80/443 taken. PHP errors also surface in error_log, FPM pool logs, and HTTP 502 from Nginx when FPM is down.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for PHP errors?
back: sudo ss -tlnp | grep -E ':80|:443' → sudo systemctl status apache2 nginx php*-fpm → sudo apachectl configtest → sudo systemctl restart apache2 → sudo tail -f /var/log/apache2/error.log

front: Symptom: no listening sockets available, shutting down — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: ss -tlnp, Apache already up · Fix: Stop duplicate Apache; free port 80

front: Symptom: Address already in use — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Conflicting nginx/apache · Fix: One listener per port; disable unused service

front: Symptom: 502 Bad Gateway — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: FPM running? socket path · Fix: Restart FPM; align socket in nginx + pool

front: Symptom: Blank page, no log — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: display_errors off · Fix: Check FPM/Apache error log; enable log in dev only

front: Symptom: Permission denied on socket — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: www-data group · Fix: listen.owner/group/mode in pool config

front: Symptom: Max children reached — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: FPM slow log · Fix: Raise pm.max_children; fix slow queries

front: Gotcha with PHP errors: what silently fails?
back: apachectl vs apache2ctl — wrong binary on Debian/Ubuntu = confusing paths. Editing php.ini but FPM uses pool ini — php_admin_value in pool overrides. Opcache stale after deploy — restart FPM on deploy or tune validate_timestamps.

front: When should you NOT use PHP errors?
back: Don't enable display_errors=On in production — leaks paths and logic. Don't run Apache and Nginx both binding :80 without intentional reverse-proxy setup.

front: What is PHP in one sentence?
back: Server-side language runtime — install extensions, pair with FPM, tune for web workloads.

front: Explain the mental model of PHP (how the system thinks).
back: PHP executes per request (FPM worker pool) or CLI (cron, Composer). The SAPI (FPM, CLI, Apache module) loads php.ini + conf.d snippets. Composer manages dependencies; autoload maps classes. Production = FPM behind Nginx/Apache, opcache on, errors to log not browser.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for PHP?
back: sudo apt update → sudo apt install php8.2-fpm php8.2-cli php8.2-mysql php8.2-curl php8.2-xml php8.2-mbstring → php -v → php -m # loaded extensions → curl -sS https://getcomposer.org/installer | php

front: Given a broken PHP setup, what is your first validation command?
back: sudo apt update

front: Symptom: Extension missing — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: php -m · Fix: apt install php8.2-<ext>; restart FPM

front: Symptom: CLI vs FPM different behavior — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Compare php -i vs FPM · Fix: Align ini files

front: Symptom: Composer memory exhausted — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: memory_limit · Fix: COMPOSER_MEMORY_LIMIT=-1 composer install

front: Symptom: Version mismatch — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: php -v on nginx vs cli · Fix: Point nginx to correct FPM socket version

front: Gotcha with PHP: what silently fails?
back: Editing wrong php.ini — cron uses CLI ini; website uses FPM ini. World-writable upload dir — RCE via uploaded .php if webroot includes uploads. Deprecated mysql_* — use PDO/mysqli.

front: When should you NOT use PHP?
back: Don't use built-in PHP dev server (php -S) in production — no FPM isolation or robustness. Don't install every extension "just in case" — attack surface and memory.

front: What is PMA token (phpMyAdmin) in one sentence?
back: CSRF token in phpMyAdmin sessions — validates that form POSTs came from your logged-in UI, not a malicious site.

front: Explain the mental model of PMA token (phpMyAdmin) (how the system thinks).
back: On login, phpMyAdmin stores $_SESSION['PMA_token'] (name may vary by version). Every mutating form includes this token. Server compares submitted token to session; mismatch → rejected. Token rotates on login/session regenerate. It's session CSRF protection, not API auth.

back: Token mismatch

back: Token mismatch

front: What are the production-safe defaults for PMA token (phpMyAdmin)?
back: PHP session file or Redis/memcached session handler Browser cookie: phpMyAdmin session id

front: Symptom: "Token mismatch" after idle — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Session expired · Fix: Re-login; increase session.gc_maxlifetime

front: Symptom: Works on HTTP, fails on HTTPS — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: cookie_secure · Fix: Enable HTTPS end-to-end or fix proxy headers

front: Symptom: Random logouts — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Multiple FPM nodes, file sessions · Fix: Centralize sessions (Redis)

front: Symptom: CSRF after reverse proxy — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: PmaAbsoluteUri in config · Fix: Set correct URL in config.inc.php

front: Symptom: iframe/embed breaks token — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: AllowThirdPartyFraming · Fix: Don't embed PMA; open in top window

front: Gotcha with PMA token (phpMyAdmin): what silently fails?
back: Exposing phpMyAdmin to public internet — token doesn't stop brute force; use VPN/IP allowlist + 2FA. Session fixation — ensure PMA regenerates session id on login (default in modern versions).

front: When should you NOT use PMA token (phpMyAdmin)?
back: Don't disable CSRF checks to "fix" integration — fix session/URL config instead. Don't use phpMyAdmin as your app's database API — it's an admin UI only.
